Meet Sundial.

A familiar touch. In every room.

Sundello’s integrated home lighting and fan control concept. A round wall dial (about a 4-inch circular display) lets you select Lights or Fan, then adjust. A companion app keeps the same rooms in hand — Living, Bedroom, Kitchen in the demo. Lights and fans stay in sync.
